seoTitle: How to Increase Your Selling Limit on eBay
metaDescription: Learn how to check your eBay selling limit, request an increase, and build the seller history that helps eBay approve higher limits automatically.
intro: eBay caps monthly selling limits to manage risk, but sellers can request an increase once they've built up enough history and performance. This guide covers checking your current limit, requesting a manual increase, and improving factors that influence approval.

steps.heading: Check your current selling limit
steps.body: Open eBay Seller Hub to see your current monthly limit on items and total value.

steps.heading: Request a manual increase
steps.body: Use the help section or contact eBay support directly to request a higher selling limit.

steps.heading: Understand what affects approval
steps.body: Your performance, feedback score, and account age all play a role in whether a limit increase is approved.

steps.heading: Link a verified PayPal account
steps.body: Having a verified PayPal account linked can help build trust and support a faster limit increase.

steps.heading: Maintain a strong seller rating
steps.body: Completing sales without disputes and keeping a good feedback score improves your chances of qualifying for increases.

steps.heading: Add new categories carefully
steps.body: Expanding into new product categories can also factor into how eBay evaluates your account for automatic monthly increases.

faq.question: Where do I check my eBay selling limit?
faq.answer: You can check your current limit inside eBay Seller Hub.

faq.question: How do I request a selling limit increase?
faq.answer: You can request an increase manually through eBay's help section or by contacting eBay support directly.

faq.question: What factors influence limit approval?
faq.answer: Your performance history, feedback score, and account age are key factors eBay considers when reviewing a request.

faq.question: Does a verified PayPal account help?
faq.answer: Yes, linking a verified PayPal account can support your case for a limit increase.

faq.question: Can my limit increase automatically over time?
faq.answer: Yes, eBay's algorithm can grant automatic monthly increases as your account builds trust through strong performance.
